metadata.title: TEDx Alkawmia | The Unsaid
metadata.description: A day for brave ideas, honest conversations, and the voices shaping what comes next. Join TEDx Alkawmia 2026.

Hero.description: TEDxAlkawmia 2026 brings together thinkers, innovators, and visionaries to unlock the thresholds of human potential.

about.p1Text: is an independently organized platform that hosts high-quality events and community-driven initiatives. We serve the local youth community by spreading valuable ideas and experiences.
about.p2: Our purpose is a philosophical cultural movement designed to foster mindset shifts and inspire lasting transformation through shared growth.
about.imageAlt: An endless corridor of open black doorframes receding into a single point of red light

list.title: Quantum Physicist & Author — Stanford Institute of Consciousness Research
list.bio: Dr. Hassan's groundbreaking research bridges quantum entanglement theory with the neuroscience of self-awareness, proposing that consciousness is not produced by the brain — it is accessed by it. A CERN fellow and three-time TED alumna, her talk dismantles the materialist model of mind.

list.title: AI Ethicist & System Architect — MIT Media Lab
list.topic: "Beyond the Algorithm: When Machines Dream Morality"
list.bio: A principal architect of the UN's AI Rights Framework, Omar builds systems that ask 'should we?' before 'can we?'. His talk confronts the silent biases embedded in every model — and the irreversible consequences of deploying autonomy without accountability.

list.title: Biophilic Urban Architect — Pritzker Award Nominee, Cairo & Amsterdam
list.bio: Nadia merges ancient Arabic spatial philosophy with living-system ecology to design cities that metabolize, adapt, and heal. She questions the fundamental assumption of urban permanence — and presents evidence that cities built to live outperform those built to last.

list.title: Generative Digital Artist — Co-founder, Void Studio, Dubai & Berlin
list.topic: "Synthesized Mythologies: Art Born in the Threshold"
list.bio: Farah trains neural networks on the world's oldest cultural archives to produce new visual myths — images that feel ancestral yet alien. Her Louvre-exhibited work challenges what it means for a machine to 'dream' and asks whether synthetic beauty can carry authentic grief.

list.title: Aerospace Propulsion Engineer — Lead Engineer, ESA Deep Space Programme
list.topic: "Deep Space Thresholds: The Next Horizon of Human Reach"
list.bio: Tarek designed the propulsion architecture for the first crewed Mars transit vehicle. His talk moves beyond engineering — into what it means for a species defined by Earth to cross into permanent cosmic citizenship, and why the psychological challenge dwarfs the technical one.

Faq.title: Questions before you book?
Faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact our attendee support team.

q1.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
q1.answer: Transfers are available until 72 hours before the event from Order Details.

q2.question: Where can I find my QR code?
q2.answer: Open My Tickets after payment confirmation. Each attendee receives a unique QR.

q3.question: What happens if payment is pending?
q3.answer: Your order stays in processing while we verify the Paymob callback. You'll receive an update automatically.

q4.question: Are sessions accessible?
q4.answer: Venue accessibility details and language support are listed on each event page.
